description: This file defines the JsonGrainStorageSerializer class, which implements the IGrainStorageSerializer interface to serialize and deserialize grain storage data using OrleansJsonSerializer with JSON format.

classes.name: JsonGrainStorageSerializer
classes.description: A serializer for grain storage that uses Newtonsoft.Json via OrleansJsonSerializer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value of type T into BinaryData using OrleansJsonSerializer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes BinaryData into an object of type T using OrleansJsonSerializer.
